name: World Land Trust partner project funding
summary: Funding for partner NGOs and indigenous organisations, mostly in the Global South, to create and protect reserves, with habitat restoration and protection alongside. Concept notes go through the Grants Connect portal.

applicant_types.quote: However, we may also support other organisations, including those with a focus in other areas (for example, development NGOs and indigenous organisations)

access.quote: Once your account is set up you will be able to select the 'Start new application' button.
